title: Cargo crosslinking nucleates AP-1 lattice formation.

verified.what_i_actually_checked: Ran paper_context.py: no PMCID, not open access, no supplement, no text-mined accessions, no NCBI links, no Zenodo/Dryad hits. One EMDB (Electron Microscopy Data Bank) API search for AP-1 cargo maps released in 2026 returned an empty list.
verified.what_came_from_paper_text_only: Everything else comes from the abstract: two cryo-EM (cryo-electron microscopy) structures of the human AP-1 complex bound to cargo, at 3.5 and 4.0 Å, plus cage-assembly, trafficking and zebrafish experiments.

a1_downloadable.note: No accession IDs found and the EMDB search returned nothing. The maps are probably deposited in PDB (Protein Data Bank) and EMDB, but I could not locate them.

a2_label_is_a_column.note: Two atomic structures and some low-throughput assays. There is no table with a prediction target in a column.

a3_inputs_present.note: No tabular inputs. The paper is a mechanism study.

a4_units_stated.note: Not applicable: there is no measurement table.

a5_enough_rows.note: The abstract describes two structures and a few mutant assays, far below 400 labelled examples. Not verified in files.

a6_fits_laptop.working_set: two cryo-EM maps plus models, likely under 1 GB

a7_counts_match_paper.note: Could not check: no files were found.

a8_label_provenance.note: The structures are experimental, but there is no label to model.

honest_claim_h3: With two structures, no ML claim is possible. The data could at most serve as one test case for structure-prediction tools.

plain_idea.one_liner: Use protein-complex structures to predict whether a cargo with two sorting signals links two adaptor complexes together.
plain_idea.train_on: Two cryo-EM structures of the AP-1 adaptor complex bound to cargo (2 examples), which is far too few to train on.
plain_idea.predict: Whether a new contact surface forms between two AP-1 complexes, judged against the experimental cryo-EM structures.
plain_idea.why_worthwhile: Membrane-trafficking structural biologists might care, but two structures cannot support a model. At best they test existing structure predictors.

ml_idea: None viable. At most, check whether AlphaFold-Multimer, a structure-prediction tool, recovers the μ1-σ1 contact between the two complexes. That is a single anecdote, not a dataset.

effort.compute_note: Not estimated: rejected at Part A.
effort.cheapest_killing_check: Count the deposited structures. The abstract says 2, which kills the project.

verdict_reason: A cryo-EM mechanism paper with two structures and no tabular dataset or label. It is paywalled, and no accessions or repository hits were found.
